Friday. Tone 8 [դկ - Plagal 4th]. Patristic Canticle for the Departed, Tone 8 [դկ - Plagal 4th]: "Eternal God" (Yavitenits astvats). Midday Psalm 97 [98]: "All the ends of the earth have seen." Epistle: 1 Corinthians 1:10 "Now I appeal to you..." to verse 18 "...the power of God." Alleluia. "Lord, your mercy." Gospel: Matthew 18:2 "He called..." to verse 9 "...into the hell of fire."

From this point until the end, [the services] are for the most part movable; for this reason, the Patristic Canticles, tones, and other variables are not set down hereafter, which you must look up in the Directory. But the feast of Saint Thaddeus the Apostle and the coming two weeks—although they are placed here as immovable—nevertheless sometimes shift, as you see from letter 'Ch' [Չ] of the Directory until 'K' [Ք]. For this reason you must always have the Directory at hand and be guided by it until the end.

Saturday. Tone 7 [դձ - 4th]. Of the Holy Apostle Thaddeus, our patron, and Sandukht the Virgin. 
In the Evening, perform the Pre-festal service. Tone 5 [եձ - 3rd]: "Blessed holy apostles," with its proper canons. And in the Night Office, Tone 5 [եձ - 3rd]: "Blessed holy apostles," with its proper canons. King eternal: "Today the ranks of angels." Magnificat, Tone 6 [ոձ - Plagal 3rd]: "You who [bore] God the Word." Hymn of the Youth, Tone 8 [դկ - Plagal 4th]: "In you boasts." Midday Introit: "Apostles." Hymn, Tone 2 [ակ - Plagal 1st]: "You who love." Psalm 18 [19]: "Through all the earth." Proverbs 1:1 "Love righteousness..." to verse 7 "...fills the world." Prophet Jeremiah 16:16 "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 21 "...my name is the Lord." Epistle: 1 Corinthians 12:28 "And God has appointed..." to 13:10 "...will be set aside." Alleluia. "Through all the earth." Gospel: Luke 9:1 "Then calling the twelve..." to verse 6 "...in every place." In the Evening: "Joyful Light." Messedi: "I loved." Hymn at Dismissal, Tone 1 [աձ - 1st]: "Holy are you, Lord," and "From you we petition," and so on.

Second Sunday after Varshavar (Transfiguration). Tone 2 [ակ - Plagal 1st]. Patristic Canticle, Tone 4 [բձ - 2nd]: "Who came down from heaven." Magnificat: "We magnify you, Virgin." Midday Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to you." Prophet Isaiah 3:16 "Thus says the Lord..." to 4:1 "...our disgrace." Psalm 33 [34]: "Proclaim greatness." Epistle: 1 Corinthians 1:25 "For the foolishness of God..." to verse 30 "...and holiness." Alleluia. "Bless the Lord." Gospel: Matthew 18:10 "Take care..." to verse 14 "...of these little ones." In the Evening, Messedi: "Your throne" / "My heart overflows." Hymn at Dismissal, Tone 2 [ակ - Plagal 1st]: "You were sent from the Father." Dismissal Litany: "Let us ask." Prayer: "Keep us." Prayer: "O King of Peace."

Monday. Tone 3 [բձ - 2nd]. Of the Holy Saints: Cyprian the Bishop, and the Forty-Five Witnesses, and the Virgins Justina, Euphemia, and Christina. Patristic Canticle, Tone 4 [բկ - Plagal 2nd]: "We bless you." Hymn of the Youth and Hymn at Dismissal, Tone 8 [դկ - Plagal 4th]: "Memory of Christ." Midday Psalm 131 [132]: "Your priests." Prophet Isaiah 46:12 "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 13 "...unto glory." Epistle: Galatians 3:13 "Christ redeemed..." to verse 22 "...to those who believe." Gospel: Luke 15:1 "Now all were drawing near..." to verse [10] "...repents."

Tuesday. Tone 4 [բկ - Plagal 2nd]. Of the Holy Saints: Athenogenes the Bishop, and his Ten Disciples, and the Five Witnesses. Patristic Canticle, Tone 4 [բկ - Plagal 2nd]: "Who in battle." Midday Introit: "The Patriarchal." Hymn, Tone 5 [գձ - 3rd]: "The leaders and pastors." Psalm 131 [132]: "Priests." Proverbs 8:1 "For this reason..." to verse 4 "...to the children of men." Prophet Malachi 2:5 "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 7 "...is of the Almighty." Catholic Epistle: 1 Peter 5:1 "To the elders..." to verse 7 "...he cares for you." Alleluia. "For your sake I endured." Gospel: John 16:33 "I have said this..." to 17:8 "...you sent me."

Wednesday. Tone 5 [գձ - 3rd]. Patristic Canticle, Tone 2 [ակ - Plagal 1st]: "Glorified forever." Midday Psalm 65 [66]: "Save your servants." Epistle: 1 Corinthians 2:12 "But we, brethren..." to 3:10 "...who builds." Alleluia. "For the sake of your name." Gospel: Matthew 18:15 "If your brother sins against you..." to verse 22 "...seventy times seven."

Thursday. Tone 6 [գկ - Plagal 3rd]. Of the Holy Holy Forefathers: Adam, Abel, Seth, Enosh, Enoch, Noah, Melchizedek, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Joseph, Moses, Aaron, Eleazar, Joshua, Samuel, Samson, Jephthah, Barak, Gideon, and the other holy forefathers. Hymn, Tone 2 [ակ - Plagal 1st]: "Who the divine."
